beats.narration_text: A little girl wore a red velvet cap her grandmother made, and would wear nothing else — so everyone called her Little Red Cap.

beats.narration_text: Her mother said: take this cake and wine to Grandmother, who is weak and ill. Keep to the path, and walk nicely.

beats.narration_text: In the deep wood, a wolf met her. Red Cap did not know what a wicked beast he was.

beats.narration_text: Where are you going so early? he asked. To Grandmother's house, beyond the wood, under the three oak trees.

beats.narration_text: Look at the pretty flowers, said the wolf. So Red Cap left the path to gather them, deeper among the trees.

beats.narration_text: The wolf ran ahead to the cottage, knocked, and swallowed the poor grandmother whole. Then he climbed into her bed.
